data.name: Catalogs.ActivityConsolidateHelp
data.value: Only their Activity classification changes. Distinct nonblank descriptions are preserved. The source Activity is removed and its numeric ID permanently redirects to the destination. Counts may change before confirmation; all source Locations at consolidation are included. This cannot be undone here. Future imports of the source name may create a new Activity; names are not aliases.

data.name: Catalogs.TransportIntro
data.value: Transport-profile keys are durable API/import identifiers. Deactivate a profile to remove it from new editor choices without changing existing segments.

data.name: Catalogs.TransportKeyHelp
data.value: Immutable lowercase API/import identifier, for example scooter.

data.name: Catalogs.TransportManualHelp
data.value: Leave blank for a manual-only profile.

data.name: Catalogs.TransportSpeedHelp
data.value: Leave blank to make Wayfarer Automatic estimates unavailable. Saved provider estimates and Manual durations are preserved.
